notes: Machine-drafted (AI-assisted) term list; not reviewed, and the least certain of the demo glossaries. Needs review by a mathematician fluent in Swahili, ideally with reviewers from both Tanzania and Kenya. In Tanzania public primary schooling, including mathematics, is in Swahili, so Tanzanian textbook usage (and terminology work by bodies such as BAKITA and the Institute of Kiswahili Studies, University of Dar es Salaam) is the main reference; in Kenya mathematics is generally taught in English, and spellings such as 'nambari' (Kenya) vs 'namba' (Tanzania) differ. Secondary and university mathematics in both countries is mainly in English, so many university-level terms below are loanwords or proposals rather than established usage.
